test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What was the previous name of the Department of AYUSH?

options.text: Department of Health and Family Welfare
Department of Indian System of Medicine and Homeopathy

solution:
The correct answer is __**Department of Indian System of Medicine and Homeopathy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Department of Indian Medicine and Homeopathy (ISM & H) **was established under the **Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare in 1995** with the goal of ensuring the optimal and focused growth of these systems.
 
• This department was renamed the **Department of AYUSH in 2003**. AYUSH stands for Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homeopathy, which are all medical systems practised in India.
 
• These systems are founded on specific medical philosophies and reflect a healthy way of life with well-established notions for disease prevention and health promotion.
 
• All of these systems take a holistic approach to health, disease, and treatment.
 
• Within the healthcare sector, successive Five-Year Plans of India (created by the Planning Commission of India and later the NITI Aayog) placed a strong emphasis on alternative, mainly indigenous, types of medicine.
 
• The Indian government established a series of committees for the development of the healthcare sector, including** Bhore (1946), Mudaliar (1961), and Srivastava (1975), **all of which emphasised the need to modernise traditional Indian medical systems.
